name: Báixuě Wángzǐ Bié Wěn Wǒ!
source:
I've transmigrated into the Queen in Snow White!? But I'm a guy! Wait...Prince Snow White!? And the hunter became my guard? 

Queen: Please don’t give me a pair of red hot shoes.

Prince: No, I'll give you a kiss.

Queen: What!? Help! There’s something strange about Snow White!

Hunter: I'll protect you, Your Majesty. 

Queen: Thanks. You’re so kind...Why are you blushing?

[From [url=https://chrysanthemumonfingertip.itch.io/mr-snow-white-dont-kiss-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我竟然穿成了白雪公主里的女王！？但我是个男人！等等……白雪公主！？然后猎人就成了我的守卫？

女王：请不要给我一双火辣辣的鞋子。

王子：不，我要吻你。

女王：什么！？帮助！白雪公主有些奇怪！

猎人：我会保护你，陛下。

女王：谢谢。你真是太好了……你为什么脸红？

[来自[url=https://chrysanthemumonfingertip.itch.io/mr-snow-white-dont-kiss-me]itch.io[/url]]
